thread:
Riley Morgan (Hiring Manager): Need to lock an offer for Jordan Alvarez (Senior ML Infra) today. Candidate has a 3rd-party offer at +18% and asks for earlier start date (10 days earlier). Can we approve a temporary pay uplift + sign-on split to close?
Sam Chen - People Ops: Share band, proposed numbers, relocation/visa? We can triage expedited approvals.
Riley Morgan (Hiring Manager): Band = Band 7 L4, midpoint base $160k. Proposed: base $175k + $35k sign-on (50/50). Start requested 2026-07-05; our earliest 2026-07-15. No relocation.
Priya Kapoor (Recruiter): Candidate will accept in writing if we match numbers today. Recruiter asks EOD deadline.
Dana Liu (Comp Committee): Base uplift ~9.4% -> requires comp committee review. Sign-on $35k flagged. I'll join expedited review.
Sam Chen - People Ops: Routing approval: comp-committee -> finance -> payroll. Marked expedited.
approvals-bot: Approval request #0xC1D9 created. Details linked. Due 2026-06-30 17:00 PT.
Omar El-Sayed (Finance): Need headcount code and budget owner. Also confirm payroll can handle 50/50 split and clawback language.
Riley Morgan (Hiring Manager): HC code ENG-ML-2026-04; budget owner Mei Tan (Eng Finance). I texted Mei for quick ack.
Dana Liu (Comp Committee): Provisional approve pending finance + payroll. Add rationale: critical skills gap, high market counter.
Omar El-Sayed (Finance): Mei confirmed budget. Finance approves one-time sign-on and uplift. Payroll can do 50/50 with standard 6-month clawback.
approvals-bot: comp-committee APPROVED; finance APPROVED; payroll PENDING.
Sam Chen - People Ops: Priya please upload SSN form and bank info to secure folder, and include drafted offer with clawback + payment schedule. Payroll will confirm and People Ops finalizes.
Priya Kapoor (Recruiter): Docs uploaded. Offer drafted with 50% at start, 50% at 6 months, 6-month clawback. Sent secure link to candidate. Candidate accepted verbally; signing expected tomorrow.
Sam Chen - People Ops: Payroll confirmed. People Ops finalizes; Riley you can extend once offer is signed. Tag Greenhouse notes with comp decision.
Riley Morgan (Hiring Manager): Thank you all. Will wait for signed offer then proceed with start logistics. Closing thread.
